decisions.scenario: Booking a moderately priced guesthouse with free parking

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I am coming into town and need help finding a place to stay.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. What kind of place are you looking for?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a guesthouse with free parking. The area does not matter, but I would like a moderate price.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Aylesbray Lodge Guest House is a four-star option in the south with free parking and a moderate price.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That works. Could you reserve it for three people for five nights starting Saturday?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Sure. Your reference number is PFGJJSBO. Is there anything else you need?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that's all. Thank you!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are welcome. Goodbye.

decisions.scenario: Finding a guesthouse after checking four-star accommodation

turns.text: Are there any four-star places to stay in the north?

turns.text: I do not have a four-star hotel in the north. There are several four-star hotels in the south.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Do you have any guesthouses instead?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have eight guesthouse listings. One is cheap and the others are moderately priced. Do you need free Wi-Fi or parking?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No. Could you give me the address of one you recommend?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I recommend Acorn Guest House at 154 Chesterton Road.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks. That's all I need for now.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!
